description: ABOUT JACLYN Born and raised in Berrien County, Jaclyn is no stranger to rural Georgia. Now, she and her husband, Jake, have raised their family in the same rural community Jaclyn grew up in. She is proud to represent House District 170, a critical part of South Georgia's agricultural region. This district spans from the southern tip of Berrien County…
